newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: C.BANK SAYS TO START LOMBARD OPERATIONS SOON.
newsitem.headline: C.BANK SAYS TO START LOMBARD OPERATIONS SOON.

text.p: Lithuania's central bank said on Thursday that it plans to start lombard operations in the near future.

"In the near future, the Bank of Lithuania intends to introduce lombard operations," Arvydas Kregzde, the director of the central bank's market operations department, told a conference on capital markets.
The central bank said earlier this year that it planned to begin lombard overnight lending to help with the liquidity situation in the country's banks.
"We are now preparing the legal basis to start these kinds of operations," he said, adding that it was too early to say exactly when they will begin.
